input.summary: Fix illusory cap basis: greater of all fees paid or payable in prior 12 months and USD 1,000,000
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap is currently measured by "Fees", defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so it is effectively a fixed USD 12,000 cap. We have aligned it to our position: the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification and confidentiality/data-protection breaches remaining outside the cap as Excluded Claims.

ops.oldText: the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
